perfMaxima.note: World-only high-quality top-down captures, moving traffic hidden, mirror excluded. Separate maxima need not occur in one frame; not a driving frame-budget acceptance test.

review.status: All 90 game frames inspected across 8 contact sheets; six 640-pixel target views checked for spawn/Dinamo, Rosetti/parking, lake, market and composer streets. The two centered skyline retakes are included in the final sheet review.
review.purpose: Capture integrity and complete playable-plus-ring coverage. Detailed agreement with live reference imagery remains available for visual review in the overview viewer.
limitations: All frames show published source df9b2e2ced83b8b30bcc8e34cf809a434b25bc27. Later working changes are excluded.

20 cells touch the exact runtime playable mask; 64 additional cells touch the exact source 600 m ring. Boundary cells include land beyond that ring, where simplified masses and sparse ground remain visible.

Six optional distant-context frames are separate from the full 84-cell playable-plus-ring survey. Sky Tower and Globalworth frames are centered on their source anchors; the other four are grid corner context.
Moving traffic is hidden; static parked cars remain visible. Mirror rendering is excluded. Render counts describe these aerial frames only.
The game uses modeled roofs, facades, canopy and ground. Coverage and source hashes do not score fidelity or mark the reality pass complete.
The camera is perspective, pitched straight down: 250 m is the ground-plane span; elevated rooftops project larger than their ground footprints.
Reference delivery and its acquisition-date, season and registration limits are recorded by the live provider viewer; these tools cache no reference imagery.

description: Complete playable-area and 600 m scenery-ring survey, with six optional distant context views.
coverageNote: 84 grid tiles cover every cell touching the source playable mask or its exact analytic 600 m scenery ring. The drive mask includes the intentional approximately 25 m legal-drive extension. Four farther grid corners and two separate skyline-anchor views provide distant context.
reviewNote: All 90 captures were reviewed on eight contact sheets, with six full-size target views and the final skyline context rechecked. These captures expose remaining coarse background masses and procedural simplifications; complete capture coverage is not a fidelity score.

collectionNotes.atlas: Source snapshot df9b2e2 · 8 November 2026. Summer, clear weather, high quality, traffic disabled. 20 playable-area tiles, 64 nearby scenery tiles and 6 optional distant context views. Later game fixes are not shown.
